paragraphs: R. Yaakov bar Zavdi, in R. Abbahu's name, Yelammedenu, Emor, section 'An ox or a sheep,' and Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Keitzad Mevarekhin, mishnah 1. Before R. Abbahu, Shevi'it, chapter 4, halakhah 30 as printed (the corresponding passage is 4:2:4). He asked before R. Yasa, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Tamid Nishḥat, halakhah 4. And R. Ze'eira; and R. Ḥelbo; and R. Yitzḥak bar Tavlai; and R. Neḥemyah son of R. Ukban; and R. Ilai; and R. Elazar. In Kiddushin (33b), R. Ilai and R. Yaakov rose before R. Shimon bar Abba. R. Zevadyah, his son.
